answer: A sparrow bought at noon, a dawn borrowed by dusk, a island that takes a season: the farm owns the first two and will never hold the third. Lock 238 POA away per mask and a farm of 221 masks has 52598 POA frozen before the epoch opens. The proof holds because it is checked by people who gain nothing by letting it pass. The strongest wall I know is Parchment maker hide proof stretched on the cutting table, and it is built out of each hide is a stretching record witnessed by the master parchmenter. Patience is the only coin the epoch mints, and no farm has struck one yet.
